title: Machine Learning
subtitle: From zero to modern AI, one landmark paper at a time
description: Primers and story-driven articles on the research papers that built modern AI, from the perceptron to transformers and LLM systems.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
subtitle: Patterns and reasoning for top-tier coding interviews
description: Learn to recognise patterns instead of memorising solutions. Every article explains the idea, traces an example by hand, gives clean C++, and ends with practice problems.

title: Competitive Programming
subtitle: The techniques that go beyond interview DSA
description: Number theory, range queries, DP optimisations, advanced graphs, string algorithms and contest strategy, with a rating ladder of practice problems.

title: Famous Algorithms
subtitle: The clever ideas you use every day but were never taught
description: Bloom filters, consistent hashing, Raft, LSM trees, FFT, RSA and more: the algorithms hiding inside databases, browsers and the internet, and why they are clever.

title: System Design
subtitle: Design large systems and reason about distributed ones
description: Fundamentals, building blocks, scaling, classic case studies and distributed systems deep dives, with original diagrams and honest trade-offs.

title: CS Core
subtitle: Operating systems, databases, networks and OOP
description: The core CS subjects every interview loop checks. The curriculum is planned; articles are coming soon.
